[b][color=#93c47d][font=Arial Black]Lohen  is a game character from Genshin Impact who has crossed over to Stardew Valley as a marriage candidate (though note: he cannot have children with the player). [/font][/color][/b]
You can freely toggle the Lohen cursor and bloody portrait on/off in the configuration menu. 

Due to the author’s limited testing, please forgive any typos or bugs – they will be fixed in future updates. Also, because the English translation was done with AI, there may be some issues. 

An extra Genshin Impact original soundtrack has been added specifically for Lohen’s story events. 

The first encounter event must be triggered on the Mountain , which then starts a series of quests. After completing the series, you can obtain Lohen’s Dagger , which deals considerable damage. 

Before 2 hearts, he will live in the Hospital . After the 2‑heart event, he will stay in his own tent set up on the Mountain. At 6 hearts, you can also unlock a warp point to the Skull Cavern . 

Lohen’s favourite items include: 
612 Cranberry Candy , 851 Dragon Tooth , 896 Galaxy Soul , 72 Diamond , 879 Monster Perfume , 107 Dinosaur Egg , 413 Blue Slime Egg , 437 Red Slime Egg , 439 Purple Slime Egg , 680 Green Slime Egg , 857 Tiger Slime Egg , 872 Fairy Dust , as well as the mod items Poison and Dragon Breath (which he will give you in certain events). 

He also likes: 279 Magic Rock Candy , 428 Cloth , 768 Solar Essence, 769 Void Essence , and 881 Bone Fragment . 
He dislikes: 74 Prismatic Shard . 

He cannot have children with the player! He also does not accept invitations to the movie theatre … (because the I was too lazy to implement that).
